response.answer: BATALEON TORNADO BEYOND MEDALS 2027 — COMPREHENSIVE PRODUCT ATTRIBUTES IDENTITY & BRAND 1. Brand: Bataleon [1] (Merchant verified) 2. Model name: Tornado Beyond Medals (also referred to as "Tornado x Beyond Medals") [2][3] 3. Model year: 2027 [4] (Merchant verified) 4. Product type: Men's Snowboard [5] 5. Board category: All Mountain [4] (Merchant verified) 6. Board subtype: All-Mountain Freestyle [6] 7. Gender: Men's [5] 8. Pro model rider: Tor Lundstrom and BYND x MDLS crew [2] (Merchant verified) 9. Design collaboration: Beyond Medals — a snowboarding lifestyle brand co-founded in 2012 by Swedish professional snowboarders Tor Lundstrom and Kevin Backstrom [7] 10. Tor Lundstrom nationality: Swedish, from Gothenburg [8] 11. Beyond Medals collaboration history: Bataleon has been working with Tor since day one of Beyond Medals, over ten years of collaboration [9] 12. Design inspiration: Combines design elements from the Bataleon Goliath (power/response) and Whatever (playful versatility) [2] 13. Predecessor model: Previously the "Beyond Medals" existed as a variant of the Whatever; the Tornado name/model is new for the 2025/26 season [10] 14. Model first available as "Tornado x Beyond Medals": New for 2026 model year (2025/26 season) [10] 15. Model description from evo: "a high-octane freestyle weapon developed in collaboration with style king Tor Lundström" [5] MANUFACTURER & PARENT COMPANY 16. Manufacturer/parent: Bataleon Snowboards is part of the Nidecker Group [11] 17. Nidecker Group portfolio: Home to Bataleon, Emerica, éS, Etnies, Jones, Nidecker, Rome, Thirtytwo and #YES [11] 18. Nidecker Group heritage: Founded in 1887 in the Swiss Alps, 100% family owned, five generations [11] 19. Bataleon founder: Jorgen Karlson, a biophysicist, who founded Bataleon in 2000 [12] 20. Bataleon US address: 55 S. Atlantic Street, Unit 202, Seattle, USA [13] 21. European representative: Low Pressure Studio, Johan van Hasseltweg 8c, Amsterdam, Netherlands [13] 22. Bataleon brand age: Over 20 years of 3D snowboard tech leadership [14] MANUFACTURING LOCATION — DISAGREEMENT 23. Manufacturing location (Whitelines claim): "All Bataleon boards are hand-built in Austria at the Mothership" [15] — NOTE: This is contradicted by multiple other sources and appears to be outdated information. 24. Manufacturing location (The Good Ride claim): "Manufactured in Dubai by SWS" [16] 25. Manufacturing location (Snowboarding Profiles/community sources): Production has moved multiple times — from Elan (Austria) → Asia → CAPiTA Mothership (Austria) → Titan Factory (China) → possibly SWS/Saudi Arabia [17] 26. Manufacturing location (MobilityDuo 2025): "commonly associated with SWS Dubai or other overseas factories" [18] 27. Comment on manufacturing disagreement: Multiple independent sources conflict on the current factory. The most recent credible sources suggest SWS Dubai or Asia, not the CAPiTA Mothership in Austria. Bataleon has not been transparent about current manufacturing location. Buyers should contact the brand directly if this matters to them. WARRANTY & RETURNS 28. Warranty: 2-year limited warranty against manufacturing defects from original date of purchase from an Authorized Dealer [19] 29. Extended warranty (2+1): Register product and sign up for newsletter within 12 months to receive a 3-year warranty total [20] 30. Direct purchase return policy: 45-day returns from Bataleon direct [21] 31. Welcome Boardstore warranty: 12-month repair and replacement warranty for factory defects [22] PRICING & AVAILABILITY 32. SideKick technology: Amplifies sidebase uplift beyond widest points of nose and tail, hull-like shape for float and slicing rough terrain [4] (Merchant verified) 63. 3BT level on Beyond Medals: Low 3BT — the least amount of 3BT in the Bataleon lineup [35] FLEX & PERFORMANCE 64. (Dual Radial SuperTubes) — six hollow carbon cylinders running parallel to board radius, delivering extra power to edges [2] (Merchant verified) 77. Positive: Set Back Inserts/Easy Pow Float — easy directional float with backseat inserts [16] 147. Positive: Quick edge to edge with good pop (user review) [39] 148. Brand reputation (forum): 3BT makes boards feel "very catch-free and comfortable while retaining the power of full camber" but "can feel a little loose in firm snow" [45] 171. Customer service reputation (user review): "the Bataleon team were brilliant, so stoked on how quickly they to respond" [39] 172. Forum user sentiment on 3BT: Some riders prefer flat-base boards after trying 3BT — "I ended up sticking with the flat based boards, I think I like them better" [47]

citation.reasoning: Whitelines is a reputable snowboard publication, but this claim appears outdated. Multiple other sources contradict it, suggesting production moved from the Mothership to SWS Dubai or other factories. This creates a material disagreement about manufacturing location.

List Price $599 (USD)

Manufacturing location claim of SWS Dubai is more current than Whitelines' Austria claim. Performance ratings are from direct testing on 4 days of varied spring conditions. List price confirmed at $599 USD.
